roles.notes: The user requested information for 'Portland village, OH'. The search results provided are for the City of Portland, Oregon. There is no evidence of a 'Portland village' in Ohio with its own sign permitting department; Meigs County, OH, indicates that many unincorporated areas have no zoning.

roles.label: Zoning authority
roles.responsibility_quote: All building development in the city must comply with the Zoning Code, regardless of other codes and permit requirements.

roles.label: Building permit and inspection authority
roles.responsibility_quote: Portland Permitting & Development (PP&D) manages building permits.

profile.ai_summary: The City of Portland, Oregon, requires sign permits for most sign installations, which are governed by Title 32 (Signs and Related Regulations) and Title 33 (Zoning Code). Applicants must determine their property's base zone and design their project to comply with specific zoning standards, which may include additional requirements from design overlays or plan districts.
